findings.observed: After initial CEO menu session and logout, manager/admin/teacher/CEO re-login on dev briefly reached schedule then returned to login without visible error. One reset did not resolve it. Production-build new tab manager login, logout to teacher, teacher menus, logout to admin and subsequent navigation passed.
findings.cause: Not established. HMR/new-bundle state suspected by parent; do not assert a role-policy failure.

findings.observed: Dev password reset displayed generic email/SMS code copy. No code request or credential change. Parent subsequently reported demo-specific copy edits.

/gpa is read-only historical GPA, not a retirement redirect. /permissions is a standalone legacy URL for the same matrix. Full document navigation clears demo RAM auth; legacy entry body/query verification needs an in-app entry or separate authenticated harness.

boundaries: Route navigation and input-path observations do not prove CRUD save, direct DB readback, all UI states or mobile behavior.
API execution evidence is separate: api-runtime.json and api-local-http.json.
Student basic-profile edit is absent in the current source contract and observed UI; Kinder marker has a separate input path.
Student list explicitly says lead combined search, enrollment/country filters and bulk actions are not provided.
Guide writer entry may create an internal draft; final guide submission or external sending was not executed.
No real accounts, production DB, email/SMS delivery or bank transfer used.
All 31 route entries were navigated, but only 25 page bodies were observed. The other six show authentication boundaries only; do not mark all S01–S04 complete.
